Built for the common field formats

Manufacturers have changed serial conventions over time. Each decoder is intentionally limited to the formats it can identify reliably.

Week + year

Carrier, Rheem, Trane

Converts production-week codes into an approximate calendar month.

Month + year

Goodman, Lennox/Ducane, York

Reads numeric or letter month codes directly from the serial.

Cycle aware

Bradford White

Shows every plausible year when a 20-year letter code repeats.

Method, limitations, and reference notes

This is a field reference, not a warranty determination. Always compare the result with the printed manufacture date, model era, installation history, and manufacturer records—especially when a rating plate is damaged or a unit may be private-labeled.
